name: Scuttler
description: Old Works worker caste: it cuts ore from the belts and strips wrecks for mass to feed replication, and it does not care who is standing in the way. Small bounty, small salvage — and there is always another one. There is no crew in the frame to kill, which is most of the reason the bounty is small.

name: Marauder
description: Old Works assault caste: it jumps traffic on the lanes, pins the hull it means to take, and holds it there for the swarm to strip. Freighters schedule around it; the ones that do not get written off. It takes the hull and leaves the pod — a pod is not mass.

name: Hierarch
description: Old Works overseer: it directs the swarm on site — which frames strip, which hold the target, which chase — and stays on the grid until it comes apart. It does not break off, and it does not talk. The repeater mast is the only fitting on it that is not a gun.
